model: physical=True, 20 ms semi-implicit Euler, browser Float64
policy: v2_physical_seed7, existing weights, no disturbance retraining
success_criterion: 10 s episode; final continuous 1 s with angles <2 deg, angular speeds <0.15 rad/s, cart speed <0.15 m/s; never |angle|>60 deg or |x|>2.4 m
random_distribution: 512 independent samples, x uniform +/-0.25 m, both angles independent uniform +/-10 degrees, all velocities zero
